articles.summary: Gentex Corporation (NASDAQ: GNTX) and Antolin have signed a cooperation agreement to bring next generation dimmable sun visors to the European automotive market. The partnership unites Gentex’s leadership in electrochromic dimmable glass with Antolin’s expertise in interior systems for global vehicle manufacturers.
articles.title: GENTEX AND ANTOLIN JOIN FORCES TO ESTABLISH THE FUTURE DIRECTION OF VEHICLE INTERIORS IN EUROPE

articles.summary: The Gentex Foundation has selected Shriya Nallan Chakravarthi as the 2026 recipient of the Amanda Clark Scholarship, which supports female students pursuing science, technology, engineering, or math (STEM) degrees. Shriya, a senior at Forest Hills Eastern High School, plans to major in computer engineering at the University of Michigan and will receive a $5,000 scholarship for the 2026–2027 school year.
articles.title: Gentex Foundation Awards $20,000 STEM Scholarship to Forest Hills Eastern High School Student
